Vintage kimono shop

If you want to buy an affordable kimono as a souvenir from Japan, I have the perfect store for you.

In Kyoto, there is a small local shop that sells thousands of kimonos, ranging from 1,000 yen to 100,000 yen. Some fabrics were made 80 years ago, and each one is unique.

So, if you are in Kyoto and want a kimono, don’t forget to visit Vintage Kimono AN Gion.
